How to order

Choose your items on the website and tap Send order on Instagram. Your order is copied for you. Paste it in our Instagram chat and send it, and we will confirm it.

Minimum order

The minimum order is ₹299, plus delivery charges.

Delivery

Personal orders are delivered within a 20 km area. The delivery charge depends on the distance. Bulk orders go by courier or direct delivery, depending on how far they are.

Chocolates

Strawberry, Blueberry and Raspberry come in white chocolate. Pistachio Kunafa, Caramel and Biscoff come in dark or milk. Nutella comes in white or milk. Plain chocolate comes in dark, milk or white.
